libraryTools.title: Material libraries for faster specification.
libraryTools.body: Explore color direction, paper texture, sample craft, customization, security and special finishing references before requesting a sample kit.
libraryTools.asideBody: Use these libraries as a working template for material meetings, client approvals and production handoff.

libraries.title: Color Matching Library
libraries.body: Reference palettes, pairing logic and color families for packaging, labels and print campaigns.

libraries.title: Paper Texture Library
libraries.body: Browse tactile paper surfaces, fiber expressions and texture directions for premium paper selection.

libraries.title: Paper Sample Craft Library
libraries.body: Connect paper samples with print, embossing, foil and other production-ready craft options.
items: Foil, UV and ink sample guidance

libraries.title: Customization Library
libraries.body: Plan bespoke color, paper weight, finish, packaging structure and sample set combinations.

libraries.title: Anti-counterfeiting Library
libraries.body: Review security finishing and traceability options for labels, certificates and premium packaging.

libraries.title: Special Process Library
libraries.body: Collect special surface processes that extend paper into memorable brand materials.
